title: Early Morning Sunwatch
text:
🌅 Early Morning Sunwatch — October 22, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B5.8​)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B9.3 (Peaked October 22, 2026 at 08:12 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 463 km/s (Elevated)
🧲 Bz: −6.2 nT (Southward)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Unsettled (Kp 3.00)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

The Sun is about 4.6 billion years old. Looking good for my age! 🤍☀️

A bright active region near the Sun’s right limb is the main feature in today’s imagery; no clear large outward event is visible.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 171 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
